inspiration.source_location: internal/infrastructure/persistence/queries/dictionary.sql:4-12 (JSON_MERGE_PATCH duplicate-key refresh and conditional VALUES fallback)
inspiration.observed_pattern: A dictionary upsert merges incoming JSON into an existing document while conditionally replacing scalar columns only when incoming values are non-empty.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as an account-preference refresh. JSON_MERGE_PATCH applies an incoming preference patch on duplicate, a non-empty incoming display name replaces the existing name, an empty name preserves it, and a new account follows the insert path; source identifiers, fields, and values are newly authored.

fixture_notes: The existing north account receives a dark-theme and SMS-alert patch while retaining its locale and display name because the incoming name is empty; the new south account is inserted with its full preference document and revision one.
determinism_notes: Account keys, JSON documents, conditional values, revision arithmetic, and final ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE account_preferences (account_key VARCHAR(32) PRIMARY KEY, display_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, preferences JSON NOT NULL, revision INT NOT NULL)
INSERT INTO account_preferences VALUES ('acct-north', 'North Account', JSON_OBJECT('theme', 'light', 'locale', 'en', 'alerts', JSON_OBJECT('email', TRUE, 'sms', FALSE)), 2)

steps.sql: INSERT INTO account_preferences (account_key, display_name, preferences, revision) VALUES ('acct-north', '', JSON_OBJECT('theme', 'dark', 'alerts', JSON_OBJECT('sms', TRUE)), 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE display_name = CASE WHEN VALUES(display_name) <> '' THEN VALUES(display_name) ELSE display_name END, preferences = JSON_MERGE_PATCH(preferences, VALUES(preferences)), revision = revision + 1

INSERT INTO account_preferences (account_key, display_name, preferences, revision) VALUES ('acct-south', 'South Account', JSON_OBJECT('theme', 'contrast', 'locale', 'fr', 'alerts', JSON_OBJECT('email', FALSE, 'sms', TRUE)), 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE display_name = CASE WHEN VALUES(display_name) <> '' THEN VALUES(display_name) ELSE display_name END, preferences = JSON_MERGE_PATCH(preferences, VALUES(preferences)), revision = revision + 1

checks.sql: SELECT account_key, display_name, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(preferences, '$.theme')) AS theme, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(preferences, '$.locale')) AS locale, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(preferences, '$.alerts.email')) AS email_alert, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(preferences, '$.alerts.sms')) AS sms_alert, revision FROM account_preferences ORDER BY account_key
